observations.behavior: Adds incremental field support and resumable manager parameters to the Metabase source, including a month-windowed query execution endpoint.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion of Metabase query execution logs with incremental updates, rather than full refresh, and supports resuming from a last-seen month.

observations.behavior: Adds a month-windowed query execution endpoint with incremental fields and a fanout for dependent database fields.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports a server-side time filter for query execution logs, enabling incremental ingestion rather than full refresh.
